name: essential-seo-toolkit-wordpress-plugin
description: Private on-page SEO audit and page-aware SEO toolkit for WordPress.

scripts.check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check opace-essential-seo-toolkit --format=table
scripts.check:json: wp-env run cli wp plugin check opace-essential-seo-toolkit --format=json
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/opace-essential-seo-toolkit wp-content/plugins/opace-essential-seo-toolkit/languages/opace-essential-seo-toolkit.pot --domain=opace-essential-seo-toolkit
